consumer: The engine's mission/dialogue turn-in eligibility check (the contact NPC's mission_goal/completion condition, e.g. an is-completed/has-mission-item predicate) asking 'is this player eligible to hand in the package now?'
scope: The mission turn-in predicate's own reach: the mission-target package item under the engine's completion-condition scope plus required mission/proximity state, NOT merely items on the avatar's person
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items enumerates only wielded/worn/inventory items as raw S, exposing none of the mission predicate's identity or scope
divergence: Player drops the quest package on the tile adjacent to the contact (or into an adjacent vehicle cargo space) and stands ready to turn it in: the engine's turn-in completion predicate over its reachable scope returns true, but carried_items no longer contains the package, so the frontend reports 'cannot turn in' — a false negative
